desc:
(24.10.2026)
Halloween theme, return of limited skins, a new quest, and some new maps!

Classic Tower Battles is a strategical tower defense game. You must defend your team from waves of enemies longer than the opposing team. This is a game based after 2017-2019 Tower Battles, while also featuring its own custom content not available in the original Tower Battles.

Original Game:
https://www.roblox.com/games/45146873/Tower-Battles
(This game has permissions from the original creator of Tower Battles, who does not have an issue with non profit fangames. This game is not meant to intentionally profit out of Planet’s IP. This game is simply a creative tribute by fans, celebrating Planet’s original work.)
